the alternative name of Ireland, from the word Milesians
mythological forebear of the migrants, name means Spanish soldier

text: Iberia is a Celtic location. The peninsula today called Spain and Portugal was a Celtic stronghold in ancient times. Myth connects Iberia with Ireland. One group of mythological migrants in the Book of Invasions were the Milesians, or the Sons of Míl. The alternative name of Ireland, Hibernia, derives from this word. The name Míl Despaine means Spanish soldier. He was a mythological forebear of these migrants.

okr.objective: Document Iberia as a Celtic location and its mythological link to Ireland.
